Animal Caregiver

Piedmont Farm Animal Refuge
“A vegan sanctuary for rescued farmed animals.”
  • Full Time
  • Pittsboro, North Carolina
  • Posted 1 day ago
  • Piedmont Farm Animal Refuge

Job Overview

We are seeking an Animal Caregiver to join our dedicated team of passionate animal lovers! Our ideal candidate would be committed to becoming a longterm member of our team, and would be excited to work alongside other staff members to help our organization continue to grow.

Piedmont Farm Animal Refuge is a sanctuary for farmed animals who are rescued from abuse, neglect and abandonment. Located in Pittsboro North Carolina, the Refuge is home to over 100 goats, sheep, chickens, turkeys, ducks, geese, cows, and one guinea fowl, who are provided with high quality healthcare, daily enrichment, and animal-centered homes. The Refuge offers tours, vegan cooking classes, and other educational programs designed to inspire a compassionate vegan lifestyle.

The Refuge is located about 20 minutes from Carrboro, Chapel Hill and Saxapahaw and about 45 minutes from Raleigh, Durham and Greensboro. Job responsibilities, qualifications and specifics are listed below.

Responsibilities

  • Daily animal feeding, watering, enrichment and socialization
  • Daily animal medications, treatments and other health care
  • Daily cleaning of animal houses and outdoor environments
  • Updating and maintaining animal records
  • Training and supervising volunteers and interns
  • Working closely with the Animal Care Director, Caregiving Team and other staff members
  • Conducting weekly purchases and storage of hay, straw, feed, and other animal supplies
  • Transporting animals to vet appointments and communicating with veterinarians
  • Maintaining neat and organized work and storage spaces
  • Capturing photographs and videos of the animal residents
  • Assisting with animal rescues and transports as needed
  • Other duties, as assigned

Qualifications

  • Previous animal experience is required
  • Commitment to the mission of Piedmont Farm Animal Refuge
  • Knowledge of and passion for animal rights issues and veganism is strongly preferred
  • Excellent animal behavior observation skills
  • Able and willing to work in all weather conditions
  • Able and willing to perform strenuous physical labor and lift up to 50 pounds
  • Able to follow detailed instructions and meet time sensitive demands
  • Able to learn and process new information quickly
  • Strong communication and listening skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including ability to interact constructively with volunteers, staff, and the general public
  • Experience managing volunteers is strongly preferred
  • Resourcefulness and ability to work independently
  • Strong time management skills with ability to multi-task efficiently
  • Able to handle confidential and sensitive information
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Google Drive, and social media platforms
  • Flexible schedule to meet onsite program requirements; weekend, evening and holiday hours are required as needed
  • Valid driver’s license and clean criminal background check

Job Specifics

  • Full time permanent position at 40 hours per week
  • Starting wage is $17 – $19 per hour, based on experience
  • Regular schedule includes weekends and holidays, as needed
  • BENEFITS: 120 hrs of Paid Time Off per year (equivalent of 3 weeks), ICHRA health insurance, opportunities for professional development & networking, mental health support, access to Premium Calm App, and discounts through the Working Advantage Program

To apply please submit a cover letter, resume and two work-related references to Lenore Braford at: lenore@piedmontrefuge.org

Piedmont Farm Animal Refuge is an equal opportunity employer. Piedmont Farm Animal prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Piedmont Farm Animal conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

 

 

Tagged as: animal rescue, animal sanctuary, animal care, volunteer management, veterinary, nonprofit

Piedmont Farm Animal Refuge

Piedmont Farm Animal Refuge provides lifelong care to rescued farm animals, educates people about the realities of animal agriculture, and promotes veganism by offering knowledge, support, and community.
